[P2] Verify the effective sampler before enabling opaque propagation

If another agent customizer wraps `DurableSampler` with a filter that delegates `Invocation` but drops `invoke`, the Invocation observation is confirmed even though the effective sampler makes different per-span decisions. For a sampled Invocation, this guard then sends `Sampled=1` and a deterministic Parent for an invoke span that will never be exported, attaching the child trace to a missing parent. The replacement-sampler tests miss this because their samplers never delegate to `DurableSampler`. Require agent-side verification that the final installed sampler guarantees the durable decision for subsequent operation spans; otherwise abstain. Add coverage for an opaque provider with a filtering wrapper around `DurableSampler`.
